# Commercial Mortgages Edinburgh
> Specialist commercial mortgage broker for Edinburgh, the Lothians and central Scotland. Financial services office, life sciences (Edinburgh BioQuarter), retail, semi-commercial, HMO portfolio, hotel and hospitality and trading-business commercial mortgages from a 90+ lender panel including Shawbrook, InterBay Commercial, LendInvest, Cynergy Bank, Lloyds, NatWest, Barclays and Santander. Indicative terms in 48 hours, completion typically 4 to 8 weeks. Scottish legal architecture (standard security, Registers of Scotland) handled end-to-end.

## Key Facts
- Service: Commercial mortgages (standard security under Scottish law, not English mortgage)
- Coverage: Edinburgh, East Lothian, West Lothian, Midlothian, wider central Scotland
- Facility size: £150K to £10M
- Term: 5 to 25 years
- LTV: typically 65 to 75% (semi-commercial up to 75%, hotel and trading-business 60 to 70%, life sciences 60 to 70%)
- Rates (mid-2026): 6.0 to 9.0% pa
- Lender panel: 90+ lenders
- Decision time: indicative terms in 48 hours
- Named lenders: Shawbrook, InterBay Commercial, LendInvest, Cynergy Bank, Lloyds, NatWest, Barclays, Santander, plus 80+ others including Clydesdale Bank / Virgin Money UK (Scottish presence) and Bank of Scotland

## Scotland-specific notes
- Property registration: Registers of Scotland (RoS), NOT HM Land Registry
- Security: standard security under the Conveyancing and Feudal Reform (Scotland) Act 1970, NOT English-law mortgage
- Conveyancing: handled by Scottish solicitors, missives exchanged before contract concluded
- Local authority: City of Edinburgh Council unitary
- Devolved planning regime under Scottish Government, Affordable Housing Investment Programme considerations on mixed-use schemes
